title: Design System: Tournova landing (The Match Call)
scope: The landing's slip world (paper, tears, stamps, League Gothic, --slip-* print tokens) lives in src/components/landing/; brand, the shared navy, UI type and the condensed title and numeral faces are inherited from the app's tokens in src/styles.css. It is the Watch-mode front door of the system in docs/design-principles.md, not a separate product.

slip-blue.note: Same value as --primary (the app navy was taken from it); named apart so print never inherits interaction states.

wordmark.purpose: Tournova beside the mark: Instrument Sans 600, 1.125rem, -0.02em, at the app header scale.

numerals.purpose: The call number in its ruled box; one per slip; poster matter, scales with the sheet. --slip-number = var(--font-numeral), Saira Extra Condensed 800; proportional figures, lone numbers only.

headline.purpose: The promise printed as the slip's title; poster matter, scales with the sheet. CSS variable --slip-numerals (named against its role).

value.purpose: Filled-in field values (court, time); tabular, never wraps; scales with the sheet in landscape.

action.purpose: The stamped primary action's label, in navy (Roboto Condensed via --slip-form = var(--font-display)).

copy-heading.purpose: The line printed on the canary copy.

print.purpose: Player names; copy lines at 700 with tabular figures.

label.purpose: Printed form labels in Ballpoint Navy sentence case Instrument Sans.

nav.purpose: Header items, Sign in included, as plain links in Instrument Sans 500, 0.875rem; Muted Ink at rest, App Ink on hover.

link.purpose: The follow link, navy Instrument Sans 600.

input.purpose: What the visitor types into the name field.

shadows.name: tear-fibres
shadows.purpose: The top tear plate lifting off the slip beneath it.

shadows.name: tear-band
shadows.value: rgb(20 20 24 / 0.3); mask: sheet outline offset 4px (0.3cqw landscape) minus itself; filter: blur(3px) (0.25cqw landscape)
shadows.purpose: The band a torn sheet casts on the one below: under the slip's bottom tear (copies-slip-mask.png) and the canary tear (copies-yellow-mask.png).

shadows.name: tear-rim
shadows.purpose: The white paper rim showing under the canary tear.

borders.name: form-rule
borders.purpose: Field underlines, number box, name field, slip dividers; in landscape the poster rules scale to 0.12-0.16cqw while the name field keeps 1.5px.

focus.name: focus-navy
focus.purpose: Every focusable element on the landing; the name field draws it at offset 0. Selection is navy with Carbonless White text; the caret is navy.

motion.name: stamp-press
motion.purpose: The CALLED stamp presses once, from scale 1.14 / -1.5deg / blur 1.5px to settled. Reduced motion: none.

motion.name: arrow-nudge
motion.purpose: Follow-link arrow slides 0.2em on hover. Only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: action-ink
motion.purpose: The stamped action's label and frame shift to Pressed Navy together (the frame is currentColor). Only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

breakpoints.name: nav-short
breakpoints.note: max-width: 'Browse tournaments' shortens to 'Browse', matching the app header

breakpoints.name: landscape
breakpoints.note: min-width 960px and landscape orientation: fixed 16:9 slip composition

plates.name: paper
plates.purpose: Tiled paper grain for the page and, multiplied over Pink Stock, the pink sheet.

plates.name: copies
plates.purpose: Canary and pink copies under the slip (copies.png is the source).

plates.name: copies-slip-mask
plates.purpose: Outline of the slip's bottom tear; shapes the shadow it casts on the copies.

plates.name: copies-yellow-mask
plates.purpose: Outline of the canary sheet: confines the copy print (cut along the tear where a line runs into it, intended in landscape) and shapes the canary tear's shadow and rim.

plates.name: stamp
plates.purpose: CALLED status stamp; the only red on the page.

plates.name: cta-frame
plates.purpose: Double-ruled stamp frame around the primary action, used as a CSS mask filled with currentColor (navy).

components.name: Stamped Call Button
components.description: The one primary action: navy ink in a stamp frame. The shipped frame is the cta-frame plate as a mask filled with currentColor; this snippet approximates it with a double border in currentColor.
components.css: .ds-call-btn { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 1.25rem; background: transparent; color: var(--primary, #22397A); border: 4px double currentColor; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-call-label { font-family: var(--font-display, 'Roboto Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.375rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.01em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-call-btn:hover { color: var(--primary-hover, #1A2C5E); } .ds-call-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #22397A); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-call-btn:active .ds-call-label { margin-top: 1px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-call-btn { transition: color 160ms ease-out; } }

components.name: Name Field
components.description: Square navy-ruled field with a printed navy label above it; typed text is Instrument Sans, caret and focus are navy.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.3rem; background: #f7f7f6; padding: 1rem; } .ds-field-label { color: #22397a; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-name { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 0.9rem; border: 1.5px solid #2f4673; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #0b0b0b; caret-color: var(--primary, #22397A); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-name:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #22397A); outline-offset: 0; } .ds-name::selection { background: var(--primary, #22397A); color: #f7f7f6; }

components.name: Header Nav
components.description: The app header's mark, wordmark and navigation above the tear; Sign in is a plain link. Navigation includes only existing pages.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.25rem 1.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background: #f7f7f6; } .ds-logo { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45em; min-height: 44px; color: var(--foreground, #171A1D); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-mark { height: 1.25rem; width: auto; flex-shrink: 0; color: var(--primary, #22397A); } .ds-nav nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0 1.1rem; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-nav nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; color: var(--muted-foreground, #5B656C); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav nav a:hover { color: var(--foreground, #171A1D); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1.5px; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-nav :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #22397A); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-nav nav a { transition: color 150ms; } }

components.name: Follow Link
components.description: Secondary route in navy Instrument Sans with a sliding arrow.
components.html: Follow a tournament
components.css: .ds-follow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; min-height: 44px; color: var(--primary, #22397A); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-follow-arrow { width: 1.15em; height: 1.15em; } .ds-follow:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 5px; } .ds-follow:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #22397A); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-follow-arrow { transition: translate 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-follow:hover .ds-follow-arrow { translate: 0.2em 0; } }

components.name: Call Number Box
components.description: Square ruled box with the printed No. label and the call number at billboard scale; one per slip.
components.css: .ds-number { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem 0.5rem; border: 1.5px solid #2f4673; border-radius: 0; background: #f7f7f6; } .ds-no { color: #22397a; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-digits { color: #0b0b0b; font-family: var(--font-numeral, 'Saira Extra Condensed', 'Roboto Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-weight: 800; font-size: 6.6rem; line-height: 0.82; letter-spacing: -0.03em; }

components.name: Ruled Field
components.description: Printed navy label on a form rule with the filled-in value below.
components.css: .ds-rfield { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0.9rem 1rem; margin: 0; padding: 1rem; background: #f7f7f6; } .ds-rfield dt { padding-bottom: 0.15rem; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #2f4673; color: #22397a; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-rfield dd { margin: 0.3rem 0 0; color: #0b0b0b; font-family: var(--font-display, 'Roboto Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.9rem; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
The landing is the Watch-mode front door of the same Tournova system described in `docs/design-principles.md`, not a separate product. Its slip world (paper, tears, stamps, the League Gothic headline and the `--slip-*` print tokens) lives in `src/components/landing/`, styled by `src/components/landing/call-slip.css`. Everything else is inherited from the app's tokens in `src/styles.css`: the TournovaMark and the Roboto Condensed wordmark, the header nav labels (Sign in stays a plain nav link, by the user's choice), Instrument Sans for labels, fields and links, the app's condensed faces for printed values and the call number, and the app's navy (`--primary`) as the signal of interaction: the stamped action, body links, focus, selection and caret. The app's navy was taken from the slip's own ballpoint print, so the page and the product share one ink. A visitor who signs in should feel they walked through a door, not into another company.

The page is one match-call slip torn off a tournament desk pad. White carbonless paper with a faint grain, ballpoint-navy form rules and labels, black condensed numerals and headline at billboard scale, and a red rubber CALLED stamp. The copies underneath (canary, then pink) peek out below a torn edge and carry the next calls. The slip reads like a filled-in form rather than a marketing layout: every element is a printed field, a filled value, a stamp, a sheet, or one of the app's own controls set on the paper.

Density is low and the scale contrast is extreme. A giant boxed number and a two-line gothic headline sit next to small, precise form labels. Paper materials (grain, tears, stamp ink, the copies' edge shading, the action's rough frame) live in raster plates; everything drawn in CSS is flat and ruled.
keyCharacteristics: Carbonless-paper ground with a tiled grain plate; no cream or aged tone.
One navy for the whole product: the app's interaction colour and the slip's ballpoint print are the same ink.
On the slip, navy acts on the mark, stamped action, follow link, focus, selection and caret; printed labels and rules are navy but never act.
The app's mark, wordmark, nav labels, Instrument Sans, Roboto Condensed and Saira carry over; only League Gothic is the landing's alone.
Red appears only inside the CALLED stamp raster.
Torn edges, stamps and the copies are raster plates, used as images or as masks.
One authored motion: the stamp presses down once.

rules.name: The One Navy Rule
rules.body: Print and interaction share one navy. What tells them apart is form, not hue: an interactive thing is a stamped frame, a link with an arrow, a focus outline or a selection; print is a small sentence-case label or a ruled line, and it never changes on hover or focus.

rules.name: The Print Never Acts Rule
rules.body: A navy label or rule is never clickable and never stands in for a control; the header nav, Sign in included, keeps the app header's neutral treatment (Muted Ink at rest, App Ink on hover) and turns navy only for focus.

rules.name: The Copies Are Stock Rule
rules.body: Canary and pink are paper stock, not accents. They appear as sheets under the slip (plate or pink fill), never as text, buttons or highlights. What is printed on a copy belongs to that sheet: in the landscape composition the copy heading's second line runs into the canary's torn edge and is cut along the tear by the canary mask, as a real carbon copy would be.

rules.name: The Printed-Label Rule
rules.body: Labels are the form's own field names, in Ballpoint Navy sentence case Instrument Sans, sitting on a rule. They name the value beneath them; they never introduce a section or sell.

rules.name: The Fill-In Rule
rules.body: What the slip has already printed (times, courts, names, copy lines) is Roboto Condensed with tabular figures where digits align; the lone call number goes to Saira and the headline to League Gothic. What the visitor reads as interface or types is Instrument Sans.

rules.name: The One Form Rule
rules.body: The header above the tear is the app's header at the app's scale. Below it, the slip is one printed form whose parts keep their proportions to each other: labels, names, the field, the action, the follow link and the copy lines grow with the sheet alongside the number and headline, never below the app's sizes and capped for very wide screens, so no part of the form is set at a different scale from the rest.

rules.name: The Poster Face Rule
rules.body: League Gothic never leaves `src/components/landing/`, and the landing never sets its interface in any condensed face.

rules.name: The Paper-Only Depth Rule
rules.body: Elevation exists only where one sheet lies on another, and every shadow follows a real torn edge: the top tear carries a soft `drop-shadow` of its own fibres, and each copy's tear casts a blurred neutral band (rgb(20 20 24 / 0.3), 4px / 0.3cqw drop, 3px / 0.25cqw blur) shaped by that sheet's own outline mask (`copies-slip-mask.png`, `copies-yellow-mask.png`: the outline nudged down minus itself). The canary's tear also shows a 2px white paper rim from the same mask. No `box-shadow` on any CSS-drawn box, and no shadow that does not trace a sheet.

rules.name: The Ruled-Form Rule
rules.body: If the slip prints it in CSS, it is a straight navy rule or a square ruled box. If it is torn, inked or rough, it is a plate.

dos: Do keep the slip world (plates, League Gothic, `--slip-*` print tokens) inside `src/components/landing/`, and take brand, interaction, UI type and the condensed faces from the app's tokens in `src/styles.css`.
Do use the app's navy (`--primary`, aliased as `--slip-action`) for the primary action, body links, focus, selection and caret; header nav and Sign in stay Muted Ink at rest.
Do make interaction legible by form when it shares the print's navy: a stamped frame, an arrowed link, an outline.
Do reuse the app header's mark, wordmark, nav labels and short-label breakpoint rather than drawing landing versions; Sign in is a plain nav link here.
Do draw the slip's structure with 1.5px Form-Rule Navy rules and square boxes (radius 0).
Do put labels in Ballpoint Navy sentence case Instrument Sans directly above the rule they name.
Do render paper (grain, tears, copies, stamp ink, the action frame) as raster plates, placed as images or applied as masks, and self-host every face.

Do keep the header at the app's scale and let the slip below it scale as one form in the comp's proportions, never below the app's sizes or 44px targets and capped near 1680px wide; keep the shared 2px navy focus outline.
Do respect reduced motion: the stamp press, the action's colour transition and the follow-arrow slide run only under `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`.
donts: Don't apply `--slip-*` tokens, League Gothic or the paper plates to Desk, Schedule, Explore or any product UI.
Don't make a printed navy label or rule clickable, or give it hover or focus states.
Don't make anything red that the visitor can act on; red is only the CALLED stamp, a picture of a rubber stamp rather than a state.
Don't add `box-shadow` to CSS-drawn boxes, cast a shadow that does not trace a torn sheet, or round the slip's printed boxes; rough corners belong only to paper and stamp rasters.
Don't use cream, aged or tinted paper for the slip; the ground is Carbonless White under grain.
Don't use canary or pink as accent colours for text, buttons or highlights.
Don't imitate torn edges or stamp texture with CSS gradients or clip-paths; roughness always comes from a plate.
exceptions: The slip's printed labels and rules are navy without being interactive, although navy means interaction in the app; they are a picture of a printed form, not controls.
The CALLED stamp is red although product red means danger, because it is a picture of a rubber stamp rather than a state the app reports.
The slip's square corners differ from the app's rounded cards.
The name field is ruled in Form-Rule Navy rather than `--border-control`; it is the slip's printed box, and its contrast on the paper is higher than the app's control edge.
